attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post, published 2024-06-15 and endorsed. Not a quotation of anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Expect' with no hedge is an unqualified expectation, so this is a forecast. 'Leading AI figures' and 'AGI timelines' come from the post's context (big players, Kurzweil example) and are a fair reading. The horizon through 2025 is kept. The statement gives no actors, measure, or threshold for 'more'.

contract.note: The contract rightly declines to score. Any set of actors or threshold for 'more revisionism' would be supplied by the evaluator and would decide the result.

evidence.note: The author's own update of 2024-06-22. Kurzweil denies revising his 2029 AGI prediction, which weakens one of the post's examples. It is the speaker's statement, not outcome evidence for 2024–2025 revisionism.

output.rationale: This is an unhedged forecast and its horizon (end of 2025) has passed. However, the statement names no actors, measure, or threshold for 'more revisionism and downsized expectations'. Any test would rest on criteria the speaker never gave. The packet also holds no outcome evidence, only the author's own update, which undercuts the Kurzweil example. The claim is too vague to score.
